+def test_named_text_wrapper_does_not_close_shared_buffer():
+    buffer = BytesIO()
+    first = _NamedTextIOWrapper(buffer, "<first>", "w", encoding="utf-8")
+    second = _NamedTextIOWrapper(buffer, "<second>", "w", encoding="utf-8")
+
+    first.write("first")
+    first.flush()
+    first.close()
+    del first
+    gc.collect()
+
+    second.write(" second")
+    second.flush()
+    assert buffer.getvalue() == b"first second"
+
+    del second
+    gc.collect()
+    buffer.write(b"!")
+    assert buffer.getvalue() == b"first second!"
+
+
+def test_stream_mixer_buffers_survive_finalization():
+    mixer = StreamMixer()
+    stdout = mixer.stdout
+    stderr = mixer.stderr
+    output = mixer.output
+    stdout.write(b"out")
+    stderr.write(b"err")
+
+    del mixer
+    gc.collect()
+
+    assert stdout.getvalue() == b"out"
+    assert stderr.getvalue() == b"err"
+    assert output.getvalue() == b"outerr"
+
+
+def test_repeated_invoke_with_logging_thread_and_exception():
+    runner = CliRunner()
+    logger = logging.getLogger("click.testing.lifecycle")
+    old_level = logger.level
+    old_propagate = logger.propagate
+    old_stdout = sys.stdout
+    old_stderr = sys.stderr
+    logger.setLevel(logging.INFO)
+    logger.propagate = False
+    handler = None
+    invocation_count = 0
+
+    @click.command()
+    def cli():
+        nonlocal handler, invocation_count
+
+        if handler is None:
+            handler = logging.StreamHandler()
+            logger.addHandler(handler)
+
+        invocation_count += 1
+        thread = threading.Thread(target=logger.info, args=("logged",))
+        thread.start()
+        thread.join()
+        click.echo("invoked")
+
+        if invocation_count == 1:
+            raise RuntimeError("failure")
+
+    try:
+        first = runner.invoke(cli)
+        second = runner.invoke(cli)
+    finally:
+        if handler is not None:
+            logger.removeHandler(handler)
+        logger.setLevel(old_level)
+        logger.propagate = old_propagate
+
+    assert first.output == "logged\ninvoked\n"
+    assert isinstance(first.exception, RuntimeError)
+    assert second.output == "invoked\n"
+    assert second.exception is None
+    assert sys.stdout is old_stdout
+    assert sys.stderr is old_stderr
+
